entry.title: Atom story
entry.content:
Atom content arrives as escaped markup, which the collector keeps as the html it already is: a paragraph long enough to read as an article rather than a teaser.

A second paragraph carries the text past the threshold that separates an article from a summary, so the story ends up with a stored copy.

And a third, for good measure, because feeds are generous like that.

div.p: Inline XHTML content is real markup inside the feed document, so it is serialised from the wrapping div rather than read as text; this paragraph is long enough to count as an article.
A second paragraph keeps the text well past the threshold that separates an article from a summary, and a third would be overdoing it, so this one ends here with a few more words.
